method: Open coding over every label site this corpus now holds, then axial collapse into buckets, per the eval-harness-first practice (>= 100 items, 4-8 buckets, one grader per bucket). Coded by Astra from the label records themselves plus the 20-item by-eye adjudication in sample3_adjudication.json.

population.note: PROVISIONAL sites are lexicon-proposed and unverified against the ink (verified_from_pixels: false), measured precision 0.60, 95% CI [0.39, 0.81], n=20. They are counted here to size the buckets, never as confirmed errors.

buckets.name: non-word, single edit
buckets.grader: deterministic - lexicon membership plus edit distance 1 to a single nearest form
buckets.note: The product's core checkable class. This is what the shipped gate's strict filter already selects, and the only bucket where the ink alone settles the question.

buckets.name: non-word, multi-edit
buckets.grader: deterministic - lexicon membership, no distance ceiling
buckets.note: Excluded entirely by the shipped strict label filter (d == 1), so every catch rate in the repository is blind to this bucket. Eight sites here are eight more than the sealed exam set has.

buckets.name: valid word for valid word
buckets.grader: comparison against a supplied source only
buckets.note: NEVER INFER A TEACHER'S KEY. Unreachable without the dictated text, by design.

buckets.name: punctuation
buckets.grader: comparison against a supplied source only

buckets.name: capitalisation
buckets.grader: deterministic case comparison, but only against a source

buckets.name: word the pupil split or joined
buckets.grader: deterministic - lexicon over the joined and the split forms
buckets.note: The class page 36's `степ пени` belongs to. Invisible to a per-token scorer, and the reason the carry fields exist in the corpus. Fifteen sites is the second largest checkable bucket and nothing in the pipeline addresses it today.

buckets.name: no correction proposed
buckets.grader: none - these need a human or a source before any grader applies
buckets.note: A site the lexicon flags but cannot correct: no single form sits at distance 1, so nothing can be asserted. 95 of the 97 are provisional. This is the queue a human works through, not a bucket a grader scores.

what_this_says: Only B1, B2 and B6 are checkable without the teacher's source - 59 of 160 sites.
B6 (15 sites, all adjudicated) is the largest checkable bucket the pipeline does not touch at all.
B2 (8 sites) is structurally excluded by the shipped strict filter, so it cannot appear in any current catch figure.
B8's 97 sites are the honest size of the human adjudication queue, not a measurement.
B3/B4/B5 total 4 sites here. This corpus is class notes, not dictation, so it is a poor instrument for key-based marking - that needs pages whose dictated source is known.
limits: Buckets were coded from label records and one 20-item by-eye pass, not from a second independent coder.
160 sites over 45 of 57 pages; 12 pages carry no label at all.
Bucket sizes inherit the provisional set's 0.60 precision wherever provisional counts appear (B1 and B8).
Edit distance was computed case-insensitively on the stored strings, so a capitalisation-only difference lands in B5 by construction.
